g.text: Example test_orb1: (orb true false) = true.Proof. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.Example test_orb2: (orb false false) = false.Proof. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.Example test_orb3: (orb false true) = true.Proof. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.Example test_orb4: (orb true true) = true.Proof. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.Notation "x && y" := (andb x y).Notation "x || y" := (orb x y).Example test_orb5: false || false || true = true.Proof. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.
The first four tests form the complete truth table for orb.Square brackets mark code in .v comments; HTML uses a code font.
